title: 1 box a month for 1 year. Now listen to my rant
text:
I have made it one year strong, I remember when they would send all handmade toys, now their site says nothing about them. I also really enjoyed how all toys were made in the US, now all the toys are from China. Winston the cat use to like all the toys and the box, now he just wants the box.

The handmade toys were the the best, but theses China toys are just not the same. If you're a lazy person, buy the box, but if you're really trying to find unique toys for your cat then you should look else where.
label: negative
